params.name: client_id
params.description: The client ID of the GitHub app.

items.docs: OAuth applications and GitHub applications with OAuth authorizations can use this API method to reset a valid OAuth token without end-user involvement. Applications must save the "token" property in the response because changes take effect immediately. You must use [Basic Authentication](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/overview/other-authentication-methods#basic-authentication) when accessing this endpoint, using the application's `client_id` and `client_secret` as the usernam
